# URL Shortener Backend — LLM guide

This repository is a Kotlin + Spring Boot backend for URL shortening.

Primary stack:
- Kotlin 2.1
- Java 21
- Spring Boot 3.5
- MongoDB
- JWT auth
- Caffeine cache
- Rate limiting
- Springdoc OpenAPI
- Prometheus / Actuator

Primary API flows:
- POST /api/v1/auth/signup
- POST /api/v1/auth/signin
- POST /api/v1/auth/refresh-token
- POST /api/v1/urls
- GET /url/{urlHash}

Read this order for low-token work:
1. CLAUDE.md
2. docs/ai/00-start-here.md
3. docs/ai/01-architecture-map.md or docs/ai/02-api-map.md
4. relevant docs/features/*.md
5. only then the exact source files to edit

Runtime truth files:
- build.gradle.kts
- src/main/resources/application.properties
- docker-compose.yml

Important note:
Some prose docs drift from runtime config. Prefer code and application.properties over README prose.
